title: Construct Extraction Result
description: What a single extraction call must report (construct-tsyfe.2.1), generalizing the ad hoc shapes already in use: node-native's buildExtractionResult envelope (lib/document-extract.mjs), the docling sidecar's { markdown, metadata, droppedInfo } (lib/document-extract/docling-client.mjs), and Docling Serve's { text, extractionMethod, characters, truncated, droppedInfo } (documented only as a comment at lib/ingest/docling-remote.mjs:24-26, not previously an enforced schema). Net-new contract definition: no extractor is migrated to this schema here, no routing logic changes.

provider.description: Embedded provider identity subset — mirrors the required core of schemas/extraction-provider.schema.json.

extractionMethod.description: Which concrete path produced this result, e.g. 'docling-sidecar', 'node-native-pdf', 'docling-serve', 'whisper'.

text.description: Normalized flat text (existing ad hoc contracts' 'text' field), kept alongside richDocument for indexing/search callers that do not need structure.

losslessWhereAvailable.description: Whether THIS extraction preserved source structure losslessly where the source format allowed it.

losslessReason.description: Required (non-null, non-empty) when losslessWhereAvailable is false. Conditional-requirement, not expressible in this schema subset (no if/then/dependentRequired) — enforced by the validator in lib/contracts/extraction-provider.mjs instead.

richDocument.description: RichDocument IR (ADR-0073, lib/rich-document.mjs). Structural shape only here; deep block/run validation is delegated to lib/rich-document.mjs's validateRichDocument rather than re-implemented in this schema.

pageRefs.description: Page-to-section mapping enabling page-aware navigation of the normalized output.

layoutRefs.description: Layout regions the provider detected (headers, footers, columns, margins) beyond the linear section/block flow.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in provider-native units, or null when the provider does not report geometry.

assets.description: Extracted binary assets (images, embedded media) with a durable id so blocks/figures can reference them.

droppedInfo.description: Reuses lib/extractors/shared/drop-info.mjs's { kind, count, reason, recoverable } shape verbatim — the same shape lib/rich-document.mjs already reuses. An empty array means nothing was silently dropped, not that nothing was structured.

qualityReport.description: Generalizes the docling sidecar's low-text-yield density heuristic (lib/document-extract/docling-sidecar.py:120-131, chars/page < 50) into a provider-agnostic fidelity signal, plus room for OCR confidence.

signals.description: Free-form namespace for provider-specific quality signals not yet promoted to a named field.

sourceGrounding.description: Page/offset references enabling citation back to the source document.
